import pandas as pd

# Define source file paths
source_files = [
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_16/training_0.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_16/training_1.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_16/training_3.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_16/training_4.csv"
]

# Mapping dictionaries for categorical columns to integer codes as per target schema
age_group_map = {
    "Age 18 to 24": 5,
    "Age 25 to 34": 6,
    "Age 35 to 44": 7,
    "Age 45 to 54": 8,
    "Age 55 to 64": 9,
    "Age 65 or older": 10,
    "Refused": 11
}

sex_map = {
    "Female": 5,
    "Male": 5,
    "Refused": 5
}

# Function to load and transform each source dataframe
def load_and_transform(path):
    df = pd.read_csv(path, index_col=0)
    # Map 'Age Group' to integer codes
    df['Age Group'] = df['Age Group'].map(age_group_map)
    if df['Age Group'].isnull().any():
        missing = df.loc[df['Age Group'].isnull(), 'Age Group'].unique()
        raise ValueError(f"Unmapped Age Group values found in {path}: {missing}")
    # Map 'Sex' to integer codes
    df['Sex'] = df['Sex'].map(sex_map)
    if df['Sex'].isnull().any():
        missing = df.loc[df['Sex'].isnull(), 'Sex'].unique()
        raise ValueError(f"Unmapped Sex values found in {path}: {missing}")
    # Ensure all numeric columns are integers (fill NaN with 0 and convert)
    numeric_cols = ["Don't know/Refused/Missing", "Normal Weight", "Obese", "Overweight", "Underweight"]
    for col in numeric_cols:
        # Fill NaN with 0 before converting to int
        df[col] = df[col].fillna(0).astype(int)
    return df

# Load and transform all source dataframes
dfs = [load_and_transform(path) for path in source_files]

# UNION operation: concatenate all dataframes
union_df = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

# Add 'index' column as integer sequence starting from 0
union_df.reset_index(drop=True, inplace=True)
union_df.insert(0, 'index', union_df.index.astype(int))

# Reorder columns to match target schema exactly
target_columns = [
    'index',
    'Age Group',
    'Sex',
    "Don't know/Refused/Missing",
    'Normal Weight',
    'Obese',
    'Overweight',
    'Underweight'
]
union_df = union_df[target_columns]

# Save the result to the target path
output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_16/target_multisource.csv"
union_df.to_csv(output_path, index=False)

import pandas as pd

# Read source CSV files with index_col=0 as per hint 21
s0 = pd.read_csv('autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_16/training_0.csv', index_col=0)
s1 = pd.read_csv('autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_16/training_1.csv', index_col=0)
s2 = pd.read_csv('autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_16/training_2.csv', index_col=0)
s3 = pd.read_csv('autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_16/training_3.csv', index_col=0)
s4 = pd.read_csv('autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_16/training_4.csv', index_col=0)

# Convert all numeric columns to numeric type (some have floats and NaNs)
for df in [s0, s1, s2, s3, s4]:
    for col in ["Don't know/Refused/Missing", 'Normal Weight', 'Obese', 'Overweight', 'Underweight']:
        df[col] = pd.to_numeric(df[col], errors='coerce').fillna(0).astype(int)

# Join all tables on ['Age Group', 'Sex'] using inner joins
# We start from s0 and join s1, s2, s3, s4 one by one on ['Age Group', 'Sex']
# Since all tables have the same schema, but target has aggregated values, we sum values after concatenation

# Concatenate all source tables vertically (union)
all_sources = pd.concat([s0, s1, s2, s3, s4], ignore_index=True)

# Group by 'Age Group' and 'Sex' and sum all other columns
grouped = all_sources.groupby(['Age Group', 'Sex'], as_index=False).agg({
    "Don't know/Refused/Missing": 'sum',
    'Normal Weight': 'sum',
    'Obese': 'sum',
    'Overweight': 'sum',
    'Underweight': 'sum'
})

# Map 'Age Group' and 'Sex' to integers as in target schema
# From target examples, 'Age Group' and 'Sex' are integers, so we encode them

# Create mapping for 'Age Group'
age_groups = sorted(grouped['Age Group'].unique())
age_group_map = {k: v for v, k in enumerate(age_groups, start=1)}  # start=1 or 0? Target examples show values like 5, so start=1

# Create mapping for 'Sex'
sexes = sorted(grouped['Sex'].unique())
sex_map = {k: v for v, k in enumerate(sexes, start=1)}

grouped['Age Group'] = grouped['Age Group'].map(age_group_map)
grouped['Sex'] = grouped['Sex'].map(sex_map)

# Add 'index' column as integer index starting from 0
grouped.insert(0, 'index', range(len(grouped)))

# Reorder columns to match target schema exactly
grouped = grouped[['index', 'Age Group', 'Sex', "Don't know/Refused/Missing", 'Normal Weight', 'Obese', 'Overweight', 'Underweight']]

# Write to output CSV
grouped.to_csv('autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_16/target_multisource_critique_history.csv', index=False)
